items.title: Democrats to Push Broader Crypto Market Structure Bill After Sweeping US Midterms: Report
items.summary: Analysts said that the Clarity Act's path has become tougher, while advocacy group Stand With Crypto has endorsed 27 winning candidates so far.

items.title: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Plunge, $428 Million in Crypto Longs Get Wiped Out
items.summary: Bitcoin plunged nearly 5% as AI stocks sank, Democratic midterm wins raised fresh policy questions, and forced liquidations erased a Wednesday rally that had been fueled partly by short covering.

items.title: Morning Minute: Democrat Sweep Pumps Crypto as Clarity Act Resurfaces
items.summary: The Dems are already talking compromise on the Clarity Act and their requests all seem logical - does the bill have new life?
